items.title: Three-Tier Afternoon Tea Stand
items.alt: A floral three-tier tea stand displays sandwiches, scones and pink pastries beside a matching cup and saucer.
items.description: A heart-shaped gold handle tops the delicate stand, with jam and cream dishes tucked beside the middle-tier scones.

items.title: Taco Sharing Station with Toppings
items.alt: Three filled tacos stand in a yellow rack behind bowls of tomato, corn and avocado beside stacked tortillas.
items.description: Colorful toppings remain separate from the large taco shells, creating a compact serving arrangement with clear individual dishes.

items.title: Dumpling Steamers with a Red Teapot
items.alt: Two bamboo steamers hold crescent dumplings and open-topped dumplings beside a red teapot and dipping sauce.
items.description: Pleated white dumplings contrast with the yellow open wrappers, while a small floral pattern decorates the rounded teapot.

items.title: Sushi Serving Boat with Nigiri and Rolls
items.alt: A wooden serving boat holds six sushi rolls and two salmon-topped nigiri beside a small sauce dish.
items.description: Green leaf garnish and folded pink ginger sit near the raised stern, keeping the complete boat silhouette visible around the food.

items.title: Slate Cheese Board with Grapes and Figs
items.alt: A dark slate board holds a cheese wedge, a cut round cheese, grapes, sliced figs and fanned crackers.
items.description: A wooden-handled cheese knife lies along the front edge, balancing the pale cheeses against the purple fruit and rough slate rim.

items.title: Mussel Rice Feast Pan with Salad
items.alt: A two-handled black pan contains golden rice, mussels, pepper strips, peas and lemon wedges beside a salad bowl.
items.description: Opened dark shells form a clear pattern across the bright rice, with the small leafy salad set behind the right handle.
